Medicare Advantage · Part C

Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurance companies approved by Medicare and provide your Part A and Part B benefits. Many plans also include Part D prescription coverage and may offer additional benefits.

Networks & costs County availability Possible extra benefits

Prescription drug coverage · Part D

Part D helps cover prescription drugs. We can review your medications, plan formularies, participating pharmacies, and available options so the comparison feels practical—not abstract.
